cim: How Artificial Intelligence Spending Impacts Corporate Balance Sheets
cim_eredeti: How Artificial Intelligence Spending Impacts Corporate Balance Sheets
szoveg_eredeti: On this episode of Iconoclasts, Global Economist Dambisa Moyo sat down with Forbes to discuss the macroeconomic implications of the global artificial intelligence investment cycle. Moyo also discussed rising sovereign debt burdens and evolving geopolitical shifts, including de-globalization and China’s strategic expansion.
